defects.title: Mobile bottom navigation bar is completely missing on /board route
defects.expected: Locked decision A1 requires: 'Header on top; conversation/board in the main area; on mobile a bottom navigation bar.' The bottom navigation bar must persist across primary mobile routes including /board.
defects.actual: On route /board at 375x667 (S-004), there is no bottom navigation bar in the DOM (body > nav is missing), trapping mobile users on the board view with no tab access back to Overview, Agents, or Reports.

defects.title: Interactive buttons and link controls violate minimum 44x44px touch target size
evidence: S-001 dom: body > div:nth-of-type(3) > div > header > button height=36
S-001 dom: body > div:nth-of-type(3) > div > main > div > div:nth-of-type(1) > section:nth-of-type(1) > div:nth-of-type(2) > div > div > button height=36
S-001 dom: body > div:nth-of-type(3) > div > main > div > div:nth-of-type(1) > section:nth-of-type(5) > div > button height=26.5
defects.expected: Locked decision A1 requires: 'Every interactive control ≥44×44 px.'
defects.actual: check:T23-touch-mobile fails with 3 buttons too small on mobile. Header menu button is 36x36px, 'Convene board' button is 142x36px (height 36px < 44px), 'Open' button is 61x26.5px (height 26.5px < 44px), and additional anchor buttons such as 'All' (52x27.25px), 'Read' (70x32px), and 'All sessions' (118x36px) fail the 44px height threshold.

defects.title: Inactive mobile bottom navigation links fail WCAG AA 4.5:1 text contrast ratio
evidence: S-001 dom: body > nav > a:nth-of-type(2) contrastRatio=2.92
S-001 dom: body > nav > a:nth-of-type(3) contrastRatio=2.92
S-001 dom: body > nav > a:nth-of-type(4) contrastRatio=2.92
defects.expected: Locked decision A1 requires: 'Text contrast ≥4.5:1 (WCAG AA).'
defects.actual: The inactive bottom nav items ('Board', 'Agents', 'Reports') use color rgb(86, 92, 108) on rgb(11, 12, 17) background, yielding a contrast ratio of only 2.92:1, failing the WCAG AA 4.5:1 threshold.

proposals.title: Dock or stick the prompt input bar above the mobile bottom nav on /board
proposals.detail: On mobile viewports at 375x667, the prompt input textarea and 'Convene board' button sit at y=696.55, which is pushed below the initial viewport fold (scrollHeight=781). Fix or stick the input bar to the bottom of the viewport directly above the bottom navigation bar.
proposals.rationale: Allows the CEO to immediately convene the board or dispatch instructions from mobile without having to scroll past the agent node graph.
evidence: S-004 dom: body > div:nth-of-type(3) > div > main > div > div:nth-of-type(3) > div > button height=36

proposals.title: Increase sidebar link padding to 44px on desktop
proposals.detail: In the desktop sidebar (<aside>), navigation links (height=36px) and agent links (height=40.75px) as well as the 'System' button (32x32px) are under 44px. Increasing vertical padding (e.g. py-2.5 / min-h-[44px]) will satisfy touch guidelines for touch-enabled laptops.
proposals.rationale: Maintains consistent interaction token sizing across all viewports and improves click ergonomic comfort.
evidence: S-003 dom: body > div:nth-of-type(3) > aside > div > div > nav > a:nth-of-type(1) height=36
S-003 dom: body > div:nth-of-type(3) > aside > div > div > div:nth-of-type(3) > div:nth-of-type(2) > button width=32

proposals.title: Add active indicator pill or top illumination pip to mobile bottom navigation
proposals.detail: While the active tab has high text contrast (16.82:1), adding an accent glow pill or subtle indicator bar above the active tab icon will make the active route stand out more clearly on mobile OLED screens.
proposals.rationale: Reinforces navigation hierarchy and instant state recognition on handheld devices under varied lighting conditions.
evidence: S-001 dom: body > nav > a:nth-of-type(1) contrastRatio=16.82

findings.notes: No horizontal overflow detected at any viewport (scrollWidth matches clientWidth at 375, 768, and 1280). No console or harness errors observed. GeistSans font loaded smoothly. Primary remediation needed for M1 sign-off is: (1) ensuring the mobile bottom nav bar renders globally including on /board, (2) adjusting button/link min-heights to ≥44px, and (3) brightening inactive bottom nav labels to meet 4.5:1 contrast.
